name: questionnaire
description: A multi-step questionnaire with single-choice, multiple-choice, freeform, and skippable questions.
purpose: Collects structured answers one question at a time with progress, validation, and optional skip.
bestFor: skippable follow-up questions with a freeform fallback
avoidFor: long single-page forms with many fields visible at once
unstructured free-text only, with no choices
